step1.description:
In this return to Astro we will get to building some stuff on the new Astro 1.0 beta with none other than Fred K. Schott. Maybe we can build the idealized Hackernews demo, and give the latest SolidJS integration a spin.

Hackernews Repo: https://github.com/ryansolid/astro-solid-hackernews
Hackernew Demo: https://astro-solid-hn.netlify.app/
